saw_lines: Most people book a private spa for one occasion, then decide by who can come along and how the room feels.
So the choice is won in the first line of the ad, before a viewer knows whether the room fits their group.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so collect one real figure like your review count and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time visitor has no reason to trust a private spa. Collect one real figure, like your review count or bookings, and lead the next batch with it.
None of your 30 live ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to book today. Put one clear offer, such as a first visit price or a friends bundle, in the first line of three new ads.

Two ads have run 60+ days, which is evidence they work, yet none of the 28 newer ads reuses their opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, changing only the setting or the time slot.

Your 30 ads open with 17 different stories, and the biggest leads 7. Each new story asks a viewer to start over, so nothing repeats enough to be remembered. Pick your two best openings and build the next batch from them.
